My name is Yixiang Xu, and I am currently pursuing a Master of Business Analytics at Monash University. I am interested in using data analysis and visualisation to explore public health and business problems. I hope to communicate complex findings through clear language and accessible visuals, helping non-specialist audiences understand why the evidence matters. Outside my studies, I enjoy photography and exploring Melbourne.
